# SYNTHETIC btmon 5.72 capture: Apple Proximity Pairing (type 0x07) for the SquachWatch tests.
# Layout copied from real captures (Company/Type/Data lines as in btmon_live_2026-09-22.txt).
# Payload = prefix(1) model(2) status battery charging lid color suffix + 16 encrypted bytes
# (furiousMAC continuity docs / Celosia & Cunche, PETS 2020). AirPods/Beats model codes are from
# the furiousMAC dissector table + InfiShark: 0e20 AirPods Pro, 0a20 AirPods Max, 0620 Beats.
# The AirTag-like 0055 is NOT source-verified: the rule under test flags ANY non-...20 model.
